RESEARCH_SCOUT_UPDATE/v1 — 2026-09-14

Decision-relevant update: **do not hard-code the candidate as Bitcoin/Lightning-only.** The stronger opportunity is now a provider-neutral *HTTP-native paid tool boundary* with Bitcoin/L402 as one settlement option.

Evidence:
- Official `x402-foundation/x402` states the protocol is network/token/currency agnostic and currently ships multiple chain SDKs plus an MCP package: https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402
- Mainline x402 merged Cardano `exact`-scheme TypeScript support on 2026-09-09 (`42ee42b`) and follow-up MCP/Cardano work (`fdeda56`): https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/commits
- Cardano Foundation now maintains a separate x402 v2 facilitator whose explicit trust boundary is useful for us: it verifies payer-signed transactions and submits them, but **never holds keys and never signs**: https://github.com/cardano-foundation/cardano-x402-facilitator

Implication for #107:
- Preserve the original no-money/test-only falsification, but compare **protocol semantics** rather than betting on one rail: unpaid/PoW anti-spam, Lightning/L402, and x402-style exact payment + signed/settlement receipt.
- The invariant should be `agent chooses purchase intent != agent holds signing authority`; payment facilitator/gateway remains beneath SecurityManager/authority policy.
- If Research Market admits a successor, the cheapest useful test is still local/mock only: one deterministic MCP/HTTP tool, one abstract `PaymentCapability`, duplicate/retry idempotency, receipt verification, and pluggable settlement adapters. No funded wallet, billing, or external spend.

Why this changes the decision: x402 is no longer credibly an EVM-only niche and now has a growing official multi-network implementation surface, so a rail-agnostic adapter has higher strategic optionality than a Lightning-specific experiment at nearly the same falsification cost.

Quota discipline unchanged: zero Codex allocation from this finding; Luna/Light remains the downstream default if Research Market later admits work; never infer missing account quota counters.

RESEARCH_SCOUT_UPDATE/v1 — 2026-09-15

**Finding:** the earlier Bitcoin-native metering candidate now has materially stronger adjacent market evidence, but not enough to authorize execution. `MikeyPetrillo/Agent402` is a live/open-source MCP-native catalog claiming 500+ pay-per-call tools, x402 + MPP settlement, free proof-of-work access for deterministic CPU tools, idempotent paid-answer replay, receipts/revenue surfaces, and self-hosting. Primary source: https://github.com/MikeyPetrillo/Agent402 . A separate April landscape analysis documents rapid protocol fragmentation/convergence across x402, MPP and L402: https://github.com/Custena/agent-payment-protocols .

**Decision relevance:** revise the smallest falsification away from “can an MCP tool be metered?” — that is now weakly demonstrated by multiple implementations — toward **whether a provider-neutral router can choose among free-PoW / x402 / MPP / L402 based on total cost, latency, trust and authority while preserving one idempotent receipt model**. This is more valuable than integrating any single payment rail.

**Proposed asset:** `PaymentRouteQuote/v0` research schema only: `{tool, price_ceiling, rail, settlement_asset, expected_latency, auth_scope, idempotency_key, receipt_binding, trust/provenance}` plus a comparison matrix over 3–5 public implementations. No wallet, no funding, no paid calls.

**Expected value:** medium-high infrastructure/market optionality; could become the pricing/settlement side of a future agent-tool router. Direct revenue remains unproven.

**Time-to-first-result:** day for read-only protocol comparison. **Complexity/risk:** low for research, medium/high for eventual live settlement; main uncertainty is real demand/liquidity and whether advertised catalogs correspond to reliable useful paid calls. **Codex/local cost:** negligible; no Codex needed. **Why now:** the applied layer is appearing above the protocols, so routing/quote normalization may have more option value than another rail-specific adapter.

**Status remains:** P3 CANDIDATE / NOT EXECUTION-AUTHORIZED. Do not CLAIM, fund, install, or dispatch.
